spanish: Tres veces en el año será visto todo tu varón faces del Señor Jehová Dios de Israel.

findings.issue: Common noun פְּנֵי is left as English "faces" instead of Spanish; the direct-object role marked by אֶת is therefore not rendered in Spanish.
הָאָדֹן is a common noun with the article, not a proper name; capital "Señor" adds a title capitalization the token does not license.

notes: Tres veces, en el año, será visto, todo tu varón, Jehová, and Dios de Israel match the remaining tokens.
